notes.title: UPDATE IS COMING
notes.content:
Dear community,

First of all, we would like to thank you, our community, for being with us all this time. Secondly, we congratulate everyone on the anniversary of Darkanoid. During this time, you’ve been helping us find some bugs that are fixed now and will be included in the next HotFix 1.0.4 update. However, we could not implement some of your wishes, but we did not waste time in vain and a surprise awaits you and other owners of mobile devices.

In early December, in the coming days, Darkanoid will be available on mobile devices. We ported our game and tried to preserve its atmosphere and main mechanics.

Stay tuned for the next update on Steam and the game release on mobile devices.

Best regards, Shezo Games team.

notes.title: We are resuming work on Darkanoid
notes.content:
Good news!
 
We will soon continue working on a new episode of Darkanoid! What can you expect:
New game mechanics 
- two new unique bonuses for the Survival mode, one of which will be able to demolish several blocks at a time!
- new drones, we have long wanted to implement drones with non-trivial abilities. For example, one of them can repair damage to blocks, and the other is able to undermine the platform. 
- new boss
- the appearance of random events in the classic mode (of course, they can always be disabled). We understand that the Survival mode is much more fun due to the alternating waves and adaptive difficulty system, so we came up with a solution that brings variety to the Classic Levels. 
 
We talked for a long time about how to make the passage of the levels more fun and nonlinear, in the end we were forced to admit that the Classic mode is somewhat stretched in the passage.  And it clearly lacks flexibility and fan base. New ideas and mechanics will bring that variety and a certain lightness to the main passage. And to keep up with the Survival mode, it will also be improved. 
 
And I think we reported that the mobile version of Darkanoid is coming out in May, well, we must admit that the development was somewhat delayed, and then came the new ideas that we decided to develop in the first place. We apologize for the long absence of news. 


Stay tuned!
 
Team, Shezo Games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/68d6e14081b6c82a0a9dc49a241c41cf5d09efd3.png[/img]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.0.3.1
notes.content:
Dear community!

In this patch, a bug with the controller was urgently fixed. 
We really hope that all the problems are behind us. 
And we are sorry that this bug has caused so much inconvenience. 

All gamepads that are not clearly recognized will be cut off [i](if it is not an xbox 360, xbox one, ps4)[/i].
Now the control will be automatically reset to default, then when you restart the control is always set to default and if you need a joystick, then again you need to select in the settings.

[b][i]The combination only works in the main menu![/i]
[/b]
You can always write to us about the problem that has occurred. Do not skimp on describing and if possible send screenshots. 

always in touch, 
Shezo Games team.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear community, we thank You for your interest in our game and for the fact that with Your help we found some bugs in the release version.
 
Meet the first update after the release of DARKANOID, in which you will find something new, namely:
"More points” - added points multiplier, which will allow You to earn more points and give you the opportunity to compete for the championship in the rating table:
- in CLASSIC mode, increases the number of points for successfully completed level. The multiplier growth step is +0.1 for each level of the game session, starting from the second level;
- in SURVIVAL mode, increases the number of points for successfully completed waves after destroying the boss. The multiplier growth step is +0.5 for waves following the destruction of the next boss.
The maximum score multiplier is X3

We have activated the option to partially support the game controller. Enjoy it!
 
Added:
- melody in the SPACE AID screen;
- sound effects: when scoring points, voicing the appearance of a black hole, going to the EXTRA level, on the SKINS & BONUSES screen, when the shield is fully charged and when it is active, and many others;
- visual effects in the SKINS & BONUSES screen when activating a subscription;
- missing text translations;
- display the sector name at the start of the level.
 
The UI was polished. The patch also includes fixes for texts and descriptions, bugs, in particular, fixed a critical bug with killing a boss when playing in portrait mode.

[b][i]Space engineers have already fixed everything, but if you find a bug, do not hesitate to report it in the community![/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/ef43038b293366c3595f34708ac92b5536d86580.png[/img]

We listen to the players' opinions, so feel free to write your opinion. Thanks to you, the game is getting better every day.
Stay tuned!
 
Sincerely, the Shezo Games team

notes.title: Update - full realise!
notes.content:
Dear community! We have reached the finish line - for the FULL release of DARKANOID!
Many of the previously announced mechanics have been added, and others have been transformed. This does not mean that the work on the game is finished, we are still preparing additional pleasant bonuses for you.
New mechanics:
[h3]Platform Customization[/h3]
The store expands your possibilities for decorating the game platform. Here are 13 skins, each of which additionally gives a unique ability and increases the comfort or aggressiveness of the game:
changing the base speed of the ball;
increase the duration of some game bonuses;
advantage at the start of the game in the form of an extra life or barrier;
expanded clip when firing standard guns, as well as replacing the latter with other types of weapons, including:
plasma gun, laser gun and rocket launcher.

Important reminder! Do not forget to choose the necessary skin with the bonus you need before playing, and some bonuses may only work in a specific game mode.

[i]Feature of getting skins:[/i]
Access to skins is provided through a subscription, which can be issued for excess currency-darkies.
You can extend and extend your subscription, but the duration of the current subscription does not expire, but increases for the duration of the purchased subscription.

[h3]EXTRA LEVEL[/h3]
A hidden level has been added to the game - EXTRA level. This is an unusual level, with its unique game mechanics and a lot of dark content. To get access to this level, you need a chip key, survive to the level with the boss and defeat the last one. Rarely did anyone manage to complete the entire level and take out all the darkies. Go for it!

[i]Where do I get the chip key?[/i]
The chip can be obtained by clearing a sector, at any level. Pirates of the Dark zone say that the probability of detecting a chip is 11%, about the same value increases the chance of detecting a chip at each next level in the current game session.
Use Cosmo help not to lose the chip, live up to the level with the boss and test your strength at the Extra level! 

The most important thing about all this you can learn from the tips during the game, do not miss and carefully study them.

Additional improvements:
Rebalance all game levels, including levels with dark deposits.
Polishing of graphic elements and effects, as well as added a stylized cursor.
Fixed a critical issue where the game might not work in a vertical position.

We listen to the players ' opinions, so feel free to write your opinion. Thanks to you, the game is getting better every day.
Stay tuned!
 
Sincerely, the Shezo Games team

notes.title: News update 0.6.5
notes.content:
Dear community! We continue to improve our project, and today we are sharing with you the upcoming changes in the upcoming patch 0.6.5:
[h3] SURVIVAL Mode [/ h3]
We have undeservedly deprived this mode of attention, but for many players it has become a priority, it is quite dynamic and unpredictable due to the random system of generating bonuses and blocks. But the game did not have its logical conclusion. We decided to correct this misunderstanding.
- Passage of waves:
Passing wave after wave will create the missing sense of completeness and give a sense of game progress.
- Improved logic for generating bonuses:
The same bonuses will no longer be generated side by side, and their very arrangement on the field will become more even.
- Changed block generation logic:
Blocks with durability> 1 will appear on the field.


While preparing this patch, we decided to pay maximum attention to the Survival mode, but we are preparing other changes for you:
  
- Graphic interface elements, we continue to improve the design, Achievement and Rating screens are next in line;
- Achievements, we will rework old achievements and add new ones;
- Rebalancing the first levels, we continue to look for the optimal difficulty and dynamism for the introductory levels;
- Hidden bonuses, the logic for generating hidden bonuses will be redesigned;
- Difficulty, we plan to implement 3 levels of difficulty, which will differ not only in the speed of the ball, but also in other parameters;
And as a nice bonus, we have prepared an introductory intro!
We hope you enjoy the upcoming changes. Follow the news!

News update 0.6.1
notes.content:
Dear community, we are not only working on improving the current and implementing new mechanics, but also updating the boss models. In the upcoming patch, you will already be able to see the updated mechanics.

[b]Boss Fighter[/b] 
Found at the end of the first chapter of the journey, the main weapon is twin projectiles.

[i] In the past millennium, such ships were found everywhere, now it is more a tribute to tradition, since the absence of guns on the rear of the ship makes it vulnerable to more maneuverable opponents. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/191d5e8480e0ae8820a0d61e639af08151e3a924.png[/img]

[b] Boss Miner [/b]
Waiting in the second chapter, the main weapon is a series of four fired charges.

[i] The outskirts of Andromeda have always been dangerous due to the lack of habitable planets where travelers would be protected by Intergalactic law and due to the incessant mining. Mining companies had to adapt to difficult conditions and a model ship was created, capable of extracting resources without the assistance of pilots and protecting prey with huge cannons. However, there are frequent cases of hijacking of such ships and now they can be found in other star systems. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/b74c8f2fca7081aed811f0ea47d90060b399a136.png[/img]

[b] Boss Battleship [/b]
The end of the third chapter is its habitat, the main weapon is a laser installation.

[i] At the sight of this ship, random travelers' hearts and engines freeze. Its guns are capable of launching navigation systems simply by aiming at an enemy object. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/de06f77d1e7fd301c92dc581a3af3c94a58528e9.png[/img]

[b] Boss Mazership [/b]
Appears at the end of the path, the main weapons are a laser and dual projectiles.

[i] No one remembers the inhabitants of what galaxy the idea came up with to create a whole conglomerate of ships. And who knows what their intentions were, but now the coalition ships are actively used for all spheres of activity, including not entirely legal ones. But best of all
 Mathership, created to seize entire empires, justified itself. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37565557/3e0c7aaa1310ba2a8f6d71324deaacd524c962dc.png[/img]

Follow the news!
Best regards, Shezo Games team.

notes.title: Game mechanic change
notes.content:
Dear Community! We hasten to inform you that in the next update of the game, the following mechanics will undergo a change and new features are implemented, namely:

1. “Bomb” - damage is distributed across all adjacent blocks, and a container like “Rock” can be destroyed by critical damage from the Bomb.

2. “Cross bomb” - the first time a rocket collides with an obstacle, the object takes critical damage; in the next rocket collisions, the damage done to the object is reduced.

3. Automatic start - if the player is inactive for the first 3 seconds, the ball from the platform starts automatically.

4. Drone-shooter - the drone has 1 life.

5. Added support for playing the joystick.

Bugs fixed:
- bonuses affecting the size of the platform work correctly;
- loss of the ball in the out zone resets the effect of any active bonuses.
 
We continue to work on improving game logics and mechanics, as well as improving the visual component of the game. Follow the announcements!

Regards, Shezo Games team.
